response.sql: WITH manager_counts AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) as award_count FROM manager_award WHERE player_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_id), total_count AS (SELECT SUM(award_count) as total_awards FROM manager_counts) SELECT mc.player_id, mc.award_count, mc.award_count::NUMERIC / tc.total_awards as fraction FROM manager_counts mc CROSS JOIN total_count tc WHERE tc.total_awards IS NOT NULL ORDER BY fraction DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

alternatives.interpretation: Include manager_award records with NULL player_id as a separate row (treating NULL as a groupable entity rather than filtering it out as non-player data).
